identity_notes: Isolated oral Gotu Kola human evidence in this retrieved scope is limited to two small monotherapy trials: 11106141 (single 12g acute oral dose in healthy subjects, positive on acoustic startle response) and 36420467 (500mg BID x12wk RCT in MCI, null on the stated primary cognitive outcome, positive only on a secondary inflammatory marker). Three other RCTs (16729760, 17324660, 37885445) study Gotu Kola only as one undosed ingredient within 3-to-9-herb combination products and cannot be attributed to Gotu Kola alone. Two case reports (16445150 night-eating syndrome, 21334992 pediatric hepatotoxicity) flag safety signals but their abstracts were empty in the retrieved record. A 2026 systematic scoping review (42391143) found only 3 small human studies on isolated gotu kola total (n=91) and explicitly states no combination-formulation human trial of Neurotain® Plus exists. Overall: the human efficacy evidence base for the label material is sparse and mixed.
